SELECT d.attendance_device_id, d.company_id, c.company_name, d.device_name FROM attendance_device d JOIN company c ON c.company_id = d.company_id WHERE d.company_id = #{companyId} AND d.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY d.attendance_device_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, dp.department_name, e.employment_status FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY e.employee_no
SELECT employment_status FROM employee WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM holiday WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND holiday_id = #{holidayId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, dp.department_name, e.employment_status, TO_CHAR(e.hire_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hire_date, (SELECT MIN(de.device_user_no) FROM device_employee de JOIN attendance_device d ON d.attendance_device_id = de.attendance_device_id AND d.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE de.company_id = e.company_id AND de.employee_id = e.employee_id AND de.use_yn = 'Y') AS device_user_no, TO_CHAR(t.check_in_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS today_in, TO_CHAR(t.check_out_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS today_out, NVL(m.work_days, 0) AS work_days, NVL(m.late_days, 0) AS late_days, NVL(m.early_days, 0) AS early_days FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN attendance t ON t.company_id = e.company_id AND t.employee_id = e.employee_id AND t.work_date = TRUNC() LEFT JOIN ( SELECT employee_id, COUNT(*) AS work_days, SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(check_in_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') > #{lateAfter} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_days, SUM(CASE WHEN check_out_at IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(check_out_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') < #{earlyBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_days FROM attendance WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND work_date >= TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND work_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) GROUP BY employee_id ) m ON m.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY e.employee_no

SELECT d.leave_request_day_id, d.leave_date, d.leave_type, d.deduct_days FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'APPROVED' AND d.leave_date >= TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.leave_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1)
